items.title: Understanding 01 / 30
items.subtitle: Classify this effect into activation condition, cost, target, once-per-turn scope, resolution operation, and restriction. In particular, decide whether discarding this card is a cost, whether the effect targets, and whether the once-per-turn clause is shared by all copies with this name.

items.title: Understanding 02 / 30
items.subtitle: Classify the activation condition, cost, target, once-per-turn scope, resolution operation, and restriction. Explain which operation depends on successfully banishing the target and how long the name-based negation lasts.

items.title: Understanding 03 / 30
items.subtitle: Separate this card's activation-from-hand condition from its at-resolution column condition. Then classify its target, cost, once-per-turn scope, resolution operation, and restrictions.

items.title: Understanding 04 / 30
items.subtitle: Classify the phase, turn-player and location requirements, the send-to-GY clause, the target, the negation duration, and any once-per-turn or lingering restriction.

items.title: Understanding 05 / 30
items.subtitle: Classify the face-down Extra Deck banish, excavation and add-to-hand operation, damage modification, draw prohibition, and once-per-turn clause. State which clauses are paid or chosen at activation and which apply after resolution.

items.title: Understanding 06 / 30
items.subtitle: Classify both branches of the activation condition, the allowed source locations for sending this card, the target status, the operation performed at resolution, and the once-per-turn scope. Does the printed operation itself negate the activated effect?

items.title: Understanding 07 / 30
items.subtitle: Classify the triggering event, the excluded phase, the send-to-GY clause, the target status, and the rest-of-turn restriction. Identify which player or players are affected by that restriction.

items.title: Understanding 08 / 30
items.subtitle: Classify the activation condition, discard clause, target status, once-per-turn scope, and negation operation. Distinguish negating an activation from negating only an effect.

items.title: Understanding 09 / 30
items.subtitle: Separate the summon effect from the delayed End Phase effect. For each, classify its condition, target, operations and once-per-turn scope, and explain what changes when the opponent controls a monster.

items.title: Understanding 10 / 30
items.subtitle: Classify the card-name declaration, Main Deck banish, target status, name-based negation and once-per-turn clause. Determine which parts occur at activation and which occur during resolution.

items.title: Understanding 11 / 30
items.subtitle: Classify the historical activation condition, the three selectable operations, their target or selection behavior, and the once-per-turn scope. Do not merge all three modes into one operation label.

items.title: Understanding 12 / 30
items.subtitle: Annotate the two effects separately: their conditions, targets, banish operations, attack restriction, return timing and once-per-turn scope. State which restrictions belong only to the first effect.

items.title: Understanding 13 / 30
items.subtitle: An opponent activates an effect that would add from the Deck. You chain Ash Blossom by discarding it as Chain Link 2. The opponent chains Called by the Grave as Chain Link 3, targeting that Ash Blossom in your GY. Resolve the Chain in order and state whether Ash Blossom negates Chain Link 1.

items.title: Understanding 14 / 30
items.subtitle: A face-up Continuous Spell that was already on the field activates one of its effects. Ghost Ogre is chained and destroys that Spell. Does Ghost Ogre negate the activation, and under what rule can destruction of the Continuous Spell still affect whether its effect resolves successfully?

items.title: Understanding 15 / 30
items.subtitle: Infinite Impermanence was Set before activation and targets a face-up monster. Another effect is chained that removes Infinite Impermanence from the field before it resolves. Which parts of Infinite Impermanence can still resolve, and is the rest-of-turn column negation applied?

items.title: Understanding 16 / 30
items.subtitle: During the opponent's Main Phase, Effect Veiler targets a face-up Effect Monster. A chained effect changes that target to face-down Defense Position before Effect Veiler resolves. Determine what Effect Veiler does on resolution and identify the relevant target-state requirement.

items.title: Understanding 17 / 30
items.subtitle: Bystial Magnamhut is Special Summoned by an action that does not start a Chain. Its optional trigger effect is available. Explain when that trigger is placed on a Chain and when the opponent receives the next opportunity to activate a fast effect.

items.title: Understanding 18 / 30
items.subtitle: Bystial Magnamhut is Special Summoned while an existing Chain resolves. Can its Special Summon trigger effect be activated in the middle of that Chain, or must it wait until the Chain has completely resolved? Describe the next response window.

items.title: Understanding 19 / 30
items.subtitle: During your Main Phase, the opponent activates a monster effect, but that effect is negated. After the Chain resolves, is Triple Tactics Talent's activation condition satisfied? Explain whether the condition depends on activation or successful resolution.

items.title: Understanding 20 / 30
items.subtitle: During a resolving Chain outside the Draw Phase, an earlier Chain Link adds a card from the Main Deck to the opponent's hand, and a later-resolving event becomes the last thing that happened. After the Chain resolves, can Droll & Lock Bird be activated?

items.title: Understanding 21 / 30
items.subtitle: Called by the Grave is activated targeting a monster in the opponent's GY. Can Ghost Belle & Haunted Mansion be chained? Identify the exact included operation that determines the answer and describe the Chain if Ghost Belle resolves successfully.

items.title: Understanding 22 / 30
items.subtitle: S:P Little Knight's second effect resolves and temporarily banishes both targeted monsters. Describe when and how the return is applied in the End Phase, and whether the two monsters are treated as newly Summoned when they return.

items.title: Understanding 23 / 30
items.subtitle: You control no cards and hold Infinite Impermanence in your hand. The opponent controls a valid face-up target. Can you activate Infinite Impermanence from your hand now?

items.title: Understanding 24 / 30
items.subtitle: You control one face-up card and hold Infinite Impermanence in your hand. The opponent controls a valid face-up target. Can you activate Infinite Impermanence from your hand now?

items.title: Understanding 25 / 30
items.subtitle: It is the opponent's Main Phase. You hold Effect Veiler and the opponent controls a valid face-up Effect Monster. Can you activate Effect Veiler?

items.title: Understanding 26 / 30
items.subtitle: It is the opponent's End Phase. You hold Effect Veiler and the opponent controls the same valid face-up Effect Monster. Can you activate Effect Veiler?

items.title: Understanding 27 / 30
items.subtitle: The opponent activates an effect whose text includes adding one card from the Main Deck to the hand. You hold Ash Blossom. Can Ash Blossom be chained to that activation?

items.title: Understanding 28 / 30
items.subtitle: The opponent activates an otherwise identical effect whose text includes adding one card from the GY to the hand, but includes no operation involving the Main Deck. You hold Ash Blossom. Can Ash Blossom be chained to that activation?

items.title: Understanding 29 / 30
items.subtitle: During the opponent's Main Phase, the opponent controls a monster. You hold Bystial Magnamhut and there is a valid LIGHT monster in a GY. Can you activate Magnamhut's first effect in the current response window?

items.subtitle: During the opponent's Main Phase, the opponent controls no monsters. You hold Bystial Magnamhut and the same valid LIGHT monster is in a GY. Can you activate Magnamhut's first effect in the current response window?

interactive_state.objective: No card has been added, the puzzle won't be saved.\nRestart to create a new puzzle.
Observe how two Link 2 monsters can make a Link 2, 3 or 4 (neither, one, or both being treated as two materials), but you cannot make a second Firewall Dragon with the first.
They can come from your hand, or face-up in your Extra Deck - that's where Pendulum monsters go from the field instead of the Graveyard.
If they're summoned ingoring conditions, sent directly to the graveyard/banished, or their summon is negated, you cannot Special Summon them again from elsewhere.
This is because its materials must be on the field.
Pay attention to the difference between Monster type and card names, and experiment with which cards you can use with each.
The levels of the materials added together must equal the level of the Synchro Monster.
Xyz Monsters have Ranks, not Levels.

27551.description: Target 1 monster with 1000 or less ATK in your Graveyard; Special Summon it in Attack Position. If the target is changed to Defense Position, destroy it and this card. When this card leaves the field, destroy the target. When the target is destroyed, destroy this card.

403847.name: The A. Forces

423705.name: Gearfried the Iron Knight
423705.description: If either player equips an Equip Card(s) to this card: Destroy that Equip Card(s).

706925.description: When this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "Atlantean" Sea Serpent-Type monster from your Deck, except "Atlantean Marksman". 987311.description:
1 "D/D" Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters

1142880.name: Cyber Dragon Nachster
1142880.description: This card's name becomes "Cyber Dragon" while on the field or in the GY. You can discard 1 other monster; Special Summon this card from your hand. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can target 1 Machine monster with 2100 ATK or DEF in your GY; Special Summon it, also, you cannot Special Summon monsters for the rest of this turn, except Machine monsters. 1475311.name: Allure of Darkness

1781310.name: Fuh-Rin-Ka-Zan
1781310.description:
When there are face-up WIND, WATER, FIRE and EARTH monster(s) on the field: Apply 1 of these effects.
● Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.
● Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards your opponent controls.
● Discard 2 random cards from your opponent's hand.
● Draw 2 cards.

1845204.name: Instant Fusion
1845204.description: Pay 1000 LP; Special Summon 1 Level 5 or lower Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, but it cannot attack, also it is destroyed during the End Phase. (This is treated as a Fusion Summon.) You can only activate 1 "Instant Fusion" per turn.

2009101.description: If you control a "Blackwing" monster other than "Blackwing - Gale the Whirlwind", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; that target's ATK and DEF become half its current ATK and DEF.

2295440.name: One for One

2403771.name: Power Tool Dragon

2460565.name: Marauding Captain
2460565.description: Monsters your opponent controls cannot target Warrior monsters for attacks, except this one. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower monster from your hand.

2530830.name: Galaxy-Eyes Cipher Blade Dragon

3 Level 9 monsters

If this Xyz Summoned card you control, is destroyed by battle with an opponent's attacking monster, or destroyed by an opponent's card effect, and sent to your GY: You can target 1 "Galaxy-Eyes Cipher Dragon" in your GY; Special Summon it.

2766877.name: Daigusto Phoenix

2 Level 2 monsters

2772236.name: Wattchimera
2772236.description:
1 "Watt" Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner Thunder monsters
This card can attack directly. If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent by a direct attack: Place 1 random card from your opponent's hand on top of their Deck.

2857636.name: Knightmare Phoenix

2 monsters with different names

3431737.name: Assault Beast

4178474.name: Raigeki Break

4896788.name: Spirit of the Pot of Greed

4929256.name: Mobius the Frost Monarch
4929256.description: When this card is Tribute Summoned: You can target up to 2 Spell/Trap Cards on the field; destroy those targets.

5043010.name: Firewall Dragon
5043010.description:
2+ monsters

5318639.name: Mystical Space Typhoon

5554990.name: Wattberyx

5556668.name: Exchange

6540606.name: Spiritual Water Art - Aoi

6733059.name: Skull Lair

6853254.name: Return of the Dragon Lords
6853254.description: Target 1 Level 7 or 8 Dragon monster in your GY; Special Summon it. If a Dragon monster(s) you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can banish this card from your GY instead.

6967870.name: Dark Scorpion - Cliff the Trap Remover
6967870.description:

7076131.name: Next to be Lost
7076131.description: Select 1 face-up monster you control. Send 1 card from your Deck to the Graveyard with the same name as the selected card.

7093411.name: Crystal Beast Sapphire Pegasus
7093411.description: When this card is Summoned: You can place 1 "Crystal Beast" monster from your hand, Deck, or GY, face-up in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell. 7165085.name: Bait Doll
7165085.description: Target 1 Set card in the Spell & Trap Card Zone; reveal that target, force its activation if it is a Trap Card, then negate its effect if the activation timing is incorrect, and if you do, destroy it. (If it is not a Trap Card, return it face-down.) When this card resolves, shuffle it into the Deck instead of sending it to the Graveyard.

7194917.name: Number 52: Diamond Crab King
7194917.description:
2 Level 4 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; change this card's DEF to 0, and if you do, change its ATK to 3000. These changes last until the end of this turn. 7391448.name: Goyo Guardian

7565547.name: Collected Power

7572887.name: D.D. Warrior Lady
7572887.description: After damage calculation, when this card battles an opponent's monster: You can banish that monster, also banish this card.

7672244.name: Shien's Spy
7672244.description: Target 1 face-up monster you control; give control of it to your opponent until the End Phase of this turn.

7778726.name: Hip Hoshiningen
7778726.description:
2 LIGHT monsters

7841112.name: Majestic Star Dragon
7841112.description:
"Majestic Dragon" + "Stardust Dragon" + 1 non-Tuner monster

7868571.name: Metalfoes Silverd

8487449.name: Jester Confit

8491961.name: Lyrilusc - Recital Starling

2+ Level 1 monsters

8561192.name: Leo, the Keeper of the Sacred Tree
8561192.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Your opponent cannot target this card with card effects, except during your Main Phase 2.

8802510.name: PSY-Framelord Lambda
8802510.description:
2 monsters, except Tokens

8809344.name: Outer Entity Nyarla

2 Level 4 monsters

9012916.name: Black-Winged Dragon
9012916.description:

37364101.name: Stoic Challenge
37364101.description: You can only control 1 "Stoic Challenge". Equip only to a face-up Xyz Monster that has Xyz Material. It gains 600 ATK for each Xyz Material attached to a monster you control, and any battle damage your opponent takes from battles involving it and their monster is doubled, but its effects cannot be activated. During your opponent's End Phase: Send this card to the Graveyard. When this card leaves the field, destroy the equipped monster.

37580756.name: Michizure
37580756.description: When a monster is sent from the field to your GY, even during the Damage Step: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.

37675907.name: Accel Synchron
37675907.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Once per turn: You can send 1 "Synchron" monster from your Deck to the GY, then activate 1 of these effects;
● Increase this card's Level by the Level of the sent monster.
● Reduce this card's Level by the Level of the sent monster.
During your opponent's Main Phase, you can (Quick Effect): Immediately after this effect resolves, Synchro Summon using this card you control. You can only Synchro Summon "Accel Synchron" once per turn.

37684215.name: Fusion Sword Murasame Blade
37684215.description: Equip only to a Warrior monster. It gains 800 ATK. While equipped to a monster, this card cannot be destroyed by card effects.

37742478.name: Honest
37742478.description: During your Main Phase: You can return this face-up card from the field to the hand. During the Damage Step, when a LIGHT monster you control battles (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand to the GY; that monster gains ATK equal to the ATK of the opponent's monster it is battling, until the end of this turn.

37744402.name: Wynn the Wind Charmer
37744402.description:
FLIP: Target 1 WIND monster your opponent controls; take control of it while this card is face-up on the field.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

37970940.name: Aussa the Earth Charmer
37970940.description:
FLIP: Target 1 EARTH monster your opponent controls; take control of it while this card is face-up on the field.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

38296564.name: Safe Zone
38296564.description: Activate this card by targeting 1 face-up Attack Position monster on the field; that face-up monster cannot be destroyed by battle or your opponent's card effects, your opponent cannot target it with card effects, also it cannot attack your opponent directly. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster leaves the field, destroy this card.

38342335.name: Knightmare Unicorn
38342335.description:
2+ monsters with different names
If this card is Link Summoned: You can discard 1 card, then target 1 card on the field; shuffle it into the Deck, then, if this card was co-linked when this effect was activated, you can draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Knightmare Unicorn" once per turn. While any co-linked "Knightmare" monsters are on the field, for your normal draw in your Draw Phase, draw 1 card for each different card name among those co-linked "Knightmare" monsters, instead of drawing just 1 card.

38479725.name: The Trojan Horse
38479725.description: This card can be treated as 2 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of an EARTH monster.

38495396.name: Constellar Ptolemy M7
38495396.description:
2 Level 6 monsters
You can also Xyz Summon this card by using a "Constellar" Xyz Monster you control as material, other than "Constellar Ptolemy M7". (Transfer its materials to this card.) If Summoned this way, the following effect cannot be activated this turn. Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 monster on the field or in either GY; return that target to the hand.

38699854.name: Book of Taiyou
38699854.description: Target 1 face-down monster on the field; change that target to face-up Attack Position.

39030163.name: Galaxy-Eyes Full Armor Photon Dragon
39030163.description:
3 Level 8 monsters
You can also Xyz Summon this card by using a "Galaxy-Eyes" Xyz Monster you control as material, except "Galaxy-Eyes Full Armor Photon Dragon". (Transfer its materials to this card.) Once per turn: You can target up to 2 Equip Cards equipped to this card; attach them to this card as material. Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 face-up card your opponent controls; destroy it.

39168895.name: Berserk Gorilla
39168895.description: If this card is in face-up Defense Position, destroy this card. This card must attack if able.

39823987.name: Sun Dragon Inti
39823987.description:
"Fire Ant Ascator" + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Destroy the monster that destroyed this card, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to half the ATK that monster had on the field. Once per turn, during the Standby Phase of the next turn after this card on the field was destroyed: You can target 1 "Moon Dragon Quilla" in your GY; Special Summon that target.

40044918.name: Elemental HERO Stratos
40044918.description:
When this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can activate 1 of these effects.
● Destroy Spells/Traps on the field, up to the number of "HERO" monsters you control, except this card.
● Add 1 "HERO" monster from your Deck to your hand.

40619825.name: Axe of Despair
40619825.description:
(This card is always treated as an "Archfiend" card.)
The equipped monster gains 1000 ATK. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can Tribute 1 monster; place this card on the top of your Deck.

40640057.name: Kuriboh
40640057.description: During damage calculation, if your opponent's monster attacks (Quick Effect): You can discard this card; you take no battle damage from that battle.

40666140.name: Ljosalf of the Nordic Alfar
40666140.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 face-up monster you control, except this card; Special Summon 1 "Nordic" monster from your hand with a Level less than or equal to that face-up monster's Level.

40844552.name: Valkyrie of the Nordic Ascendant
40844552.description:
(This card is not treated as a "Valkyrie" card.)
When this card is Normal Summoned, if your opponent controls a monster and you control no other cards: You can banish 2 "Nordic" monsters from your hand; Special Summon 2 "Einherjar Tokens" (Warrior/EARTH/Level 4/ATK 1000/DEF 1000) in Defense Position.

41091257.name: SPYRAL Super Agent
41091257.description: If this card is in your hand: You can declare 1 card type (Monster, Spell, or Trap); reveal the top card of your opponent's Deck, and if you do, Special Summon this card if it is a card of that type. If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of a "SPYRAL" card: You can target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy it. You can only use each effect of "SPYRAL Super Agent" once per turn.

41142615.name: The Cheerful Coffin
41142615.description: Discard up to 3 Monster Cards from your hand to the Graveyard.

41209827.name: Starving Venom Fusion Dragon
41209827.description:
2 DARK monsters on the field, except Tokens
If this card is Fusion Summoned: You can make this card gain ATK equal to 1 opponent's Special Summoned monster, until the end of this turn. Once per turn: You can target 1 Level 5 or higher monster your opponent controls; until the End Phase, this card's name becomes that monster's original name, and replace this effect with that monster's original effects. If this Fusion Summoned card is destroyed: You can destroy all your opponent's Special Summoned monsters.

41375811.name: Zoodiac Chakanine
41375811.description:
2+ Level 4 monsters
Once per turn, you can also Xyz Summon "Zoodiac Chakanine" by using 1 "Zoodiac" monster you control with a different name as material. (Transfer its materials to this card.) Gains ATK/DEF equal to the ATK/DEF of all "Zoodiac" monsters attached to it as material. Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 "Zoodiac" monster in your GY; Special Summon it, but for the rest of this turn, its effects are negated, also it cannot be used as material for an Xyz Summon.

41398771.name: Curse of Aging
41398771.description: Discard 1 card; all monsters your opponent currently controls lose 500 ATK/DEF until the end of this turn.

41410651.name: Mathmech Billionblade Nayuta
41410651.description: Equip only to a Cyberse monster. If the equipped monster battles an opponent's monster, during damage calculation: You can send 1 "Mathmech" monster from your Deck to the GY; the equipped monster gains ATK equal to the sent monster's ATK, until the end of this turn (even if this card leaves the field). If this card is sent from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY: You can target 1 "Mathmech" card in your GY, except "Mathmech Billionblade Nayuta"; add it to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Mathmech Billionblade Nayuta" once per turn.

41517789.name: Star Eater
41517789.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Must be Synchro Summoned, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. This card's Synchro Summon cannot be negated. When Synchro Summoned, cards and effects cannot be activated. If this card attacks, it is unaffected by other card effects until the end of the Damage Step.

41788781.name: Guldfaxe of the Nordic Beasts
41788781.description: If your opponent controls a Synchro Monster and you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

41999284.name: Linkuriboh
41999284.description:
1 Level 1 monster
When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can Tribute this card; change that opponent's monster's ATK to 0, until the end of this turn. If this card is in your GY (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 Level 1 monster; Special Summon this card. You can only use this effect of "Linkuriboh" once per turn.

42035044.name: Panther Warrior
42035044.description: This card cannot declare an attack unless you Tribute 1 monster.

42079445.name: Descending Lost Star
42079445.description: Target 1 Synchro Monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in Defense Position, but its effects are negated, its Level is reduced by 1, its DEF becomes 0, also its battle position cannot be changed.

42110604.name: Hi-Speedroid Chanbara
42110604.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
This card can make a second attack during each Battle Phase. At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles: It gains 200 ATK. If this card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 of your banished "Speedroid" cards; add it to your hand. You can only Special Summon "Hi-Speedroid Chanbara(s)" once per turn.

42303365.name: Reptilianne Viper
42303365.description: When this card is Normal Summoned, you can select and take control of 1 face-up monster with 0 ATK your opponent controls.

42632209.name: Geomathmech Final Sigma
42632209.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Unaffected by card effects, except "Mathmech" cards, while in the Extra Monster Zone. If this card in the Extra Monster Zone battles an opponent's monster, any battle damage it inflicts to your opponent is doubled. If this card is destroyed by battle, or if this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card effect: You can add 1 "Mathmech" card from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Geomathmech Final Sigma" once per turn.

42709949.name: Phalanx Pike
42709949.description: The equipped monster gains 900 ATK for each card in either Graveyard that has the same name it does.

42829885.name: The Forceful Sentry
42829885.description: Look at your opponent's hand. Select 1 card among them and return it to his/her Deck. The Deck is then shuffled.

42945701.name: Spiritual Fire Art - Kurenai
42945701.description: Tribute 1 FIRE monster; inflict damage to your opponent equal to that monster's original ATK.

42956963.name: Nightmare Archfiends
42956963.description: Tribute 1 monster; Special Summon 3 "Nightmare Archfiend Tokens" (Fiend-Type/DARK/Level 6/ATK 2000/DEF 2000) to your opponent's field in Attack Position. Each time 1 is destroyed, its controller takes 800 damage.

43002864.name: Reptilianne Gardna
43002864.description: When this card you control is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard, add 1 "Reptilianne" monster from your Deck to your hand.

43191636.name: Phantom Dragonray Bronto
43191636.description:
This card is treated as a Normal Monster while face-up on the field or in the Graveyard. While this card is face-up on the field, you can Normal Summon it to have it be treated as an Effect Monster with this effect:
● The original ATK of this card becomes 2300. If this card attacks, it is changed to Defense Position at the end of the Battle Phase. This card's battle position cannot be changed until the end of your next turn, except with a card effect.

43202238.name: Yazi, Evil of the Yang Zing
43202238.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
Your opponent cannot target this card on the field with card effects. You can only use each of these effects of "Yazi, Evil of the Yang Zing" once per turn.
● You can target 1 "Yang Zing" monster you control and 1 card your opponent controls; destroy them.
● When this card you control is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to your GY: You can Special Summon 1 Wyrm monster from your Deck in Defense Position.

43385557.name: Magical Android
43385557.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
During each of your End Phases: Gain 600 LP for each Psychic-Type monster you currently control.

43422537.name: Double Summon
43422537.description: You can conduct 2 Normal Summons/Sets this turn, not just 1.

43490025.name: Number F0: Utopic Future Slash
43490025.description:
2 Xyz Monsters with the same Rank, except "Number" monsters
(This card's original Rank is always treated as 1.)
You can also Xyz Summon this card by using a "Utopia" monster or "Number F0: Utopic Future" you control as material. (Transfer its materials to this card.) Gains 500 ATK for each "Number" Xyz Monster in the GYs. Cannot be destroyed by battle. Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card; this card can make a second attack during each Battle Phase this turn.

43641473.name: Tailor of the Fickle
43641473.description: Switch 1 Equip Card equipped to a monster to another correct target.

43642620.name: Zombie Mammoth
43642620.description: Destroy this card if you do not have a Zombie-Type monster in your Graveyard. When this face-up card is destroyed, inflict damage to its controller equal to its original ATK.

43694650.name: Danger!? Jackalope?
43694650.description: You can reveal this card in your hand; your opponent randomly chooses 1 card from your entire hand, then you discard the chosen card. Then, if the discarded card was not "Danger!? Jackalope?", Special Summon 1 "Danger!? Jackalope?" from your hand, and if you do, draw 1 card. If this card is discarded: You can Special Summon 1 "Danger!" monster from your Deck in Defense Position, except "Danger!? Jackalope?". You can only use this effect of "Danger!? Jackalope?" once per turn.

43898403.name: Twin Twisters
43898403.description: Discard 1 card, then target up to 2 Spells/Traps on the field; destroy them.

44508094.name: Stardust Dragon
44508094.description:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
When a card or effect is activated that would destroy a card(s) on the field (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. During the End Phase, if the previous effect was applied this turn: You can Special Summon this card from your GY.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

44656491.name: Messenger of Peace
44656491.description: Monsters with 1500 or more ATK cannot declare an attack. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, pay 100 LP or destroy this card.

44852429.name: D/D/D Cursed King Siegfried
44852429.description:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner "D/D" monsters
During either player's turn: You can target 1 face-up Spell/Trap Card on the field; that target has its effects negated, until the next Standby Phase. You can only use this effect of "D/D/D Cursed King Siegfried" once per turn. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect and sent to the Graveyard: Gain 1000 LP for each "Dark Contract" card you control.

44883830.name: Des Croaking
44883830.description: Activate only while you control 3 face-up "Des Frogs". Destroy all cards your opponent controls.

44944304.name: Performapal Laugh Maker
44944304.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once per turn, if your opponent controls a monster whose current ATK is higher than its original ATK: You can gain 1000 LP.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
When this card declares an attack: You can make this card gain 1000 ATK for each monster on the field whose current ATK is higher than its original ATK, except other monsters you control, until the end of the Battle Phase. If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect while its current ATK is higher than its original ATK: You can target 1 monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon it. You can only use 1 monster effect of "Performapal Laugh Maker" per turn, and only once that turn.

44954628.name: B.E.S. Tetran
44954628.description: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 3 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card attacks or is attacked, remove 1 counter from this card at the end of the Damage Step. If you cannot, destroy it. Once per turn, you can remove 1 counter on this card to destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card on the field.

44968687.name: The Legendary Fisherman III
44968687.description: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by Tributing 1 "The Legendary Fisherman". When this card is Special Summoned: You can banish all monsters your opponent controls, also this card cannot attack this turn. Cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects, also unaffected by Spell/Trap effects. Once per turn: You can return as many of your opponent's banished cards as possible to their GY, and if you do, the first battle or effect damage your opponent takes this turn becomes doubled.

45170821.name: Vision HERO Adoration
45170821.description:
2 "HERO" monsters
Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls and 1 other "HERO" monster you control; the opponent's targeted monster loses ATK and DEF equal to the ATK of your targeted monster, until the end of this turn.

45195443.name: Elemental HERO Solid Soldier
45195443.description: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower "HERO" monster from your hand. If this card is sent from the Monster Zone to the GY by a Spell effect: You can target 1 "HERO" monster in your GY, except "Elemental HERO Solid Soldier"; Special Summon it in Defense Position. You can only use this effect of "Elemental HERO Solid Soldier" once per turn.

45206713.name: D/D Swirl Slime
45206713.description: If this card is in your hand: You can Fusion Summon 1 "D/D/D" Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck, using monsters from your hand as Fusion Materials, including this card. You can banish this card from your GY; Special Summon 1 "D/D" monster from your hand. You can only use each effect of "D/D Swirl Slime" once per turn.

45305419.name: Symbol of Heritage
45305419.description: Activate only while there are 3 Monster Cards with the same name in your Graveyard. Select 1 of those monsters, Special Summon it, and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, destroy the equipped monster.

45450218.name: Ally of Justice Omni-Weapon
45450218.description: If this card destroys a LIGHT monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Draw 1 card, then if you drew a Level 4 or lower DARK monster, you can reveal that card and Special Summon it.

45836982.name: Earthbound Greater Linewalker
45836982.description: If you control a Synchro Monster(s) and have a Synchro Monster(s) in your GY: You can Special Summon this card from your hand. During your Main Phase: You can add 1 "Earthbound Immortal" monster from your Deck or GY to your hand. If an "Earthbound Immortal" monster is Normal Summoned while this monster is on the field: You can make your opponent's LP 3000. You can only use each effect of "Earthbound Greater Linewalker" once per turn.

45939841.name: Twister
45939841.description: Pay 500 LP, then target 1 face-up Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

45986603.name: Snatch Steal
45986603.description: Equip only to a monster your opponent controls. Take control of the equipped monster. During each of your opponent's Standby Phases: They gain 1000 Life Points.

46272804.name: Lancer Lindwurm
46272804.description: If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

46372010.name: Dark Contract with the Gate
46372010.description: During your Main Phase: You can add 1 "D/D" monster from your Deck to your hand. You can only use this effect of "Dark Contract with the Gate" once per turn. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Take 1000 damage.

46652477.name: The Transmigration Prophecy
46652477.description: Target 2 cards in the GY(s); shuffle those targets into the Deck(s).

46668237.name: Green Baboon, Defender of the Forest
46668237.description: When a face-up Beast monster you control is destroyed and sent to the GY, while this card is in your hand or GY (except during the Damage Step): You can pay 1000 LP; Special Summon this card.

46724542.name: Cyber Dragon Sieger
46724542.description:
2 Machine monsters, including "Cyber Dragon"
This card's name becomes "Cyber Dragon" while on the field or in the GY. During each Battle Phase, if this card has not declared an attack (Quick Effect): You can target 1 Machine monster you control with 2100 or more ATK; for the rest of this turn, that monster gains 2100 ATK/DEF, also neither player takes any battle damage from attacks involving this monster. You can only use this effect of "Cyber Dragon Sieger" once per turn.

46772449.name: Evilswarm Exciton Knight
46772449.description:
2 Level 4 monsters
Once per chain, during your Main Phase or your opponent's Battle Phase, if your opponent has more total cards in their hand and field than you do (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; destroy all other cards on the field, also your opponent takes no further damage this turn.

46796664.name: D/D Savant Copernicus
46796664.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
You cannot Pendulum Summon monsters, except "D/D" monsters. This effect cannot be negated. Once, while this card is in your Pendulum Zone, you can negate an activated Spell effect that would inflict damage to you, then destroy this card.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 "D/D" or "Dark Contract" card from your Deck to the GY, except "D/D Savant Copernicus". You can only use this effect of "D/D Savant Copernicus" once per turn.

46895036.name: Ghostrick Dullahan
46895036.description:
2 Level 1 monsters
This card gains 200 ATK for each "Ghostrick" card you control. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 face-up monster on the field; halve its ATK, until the end of this turn. If this card is sent to the GY: You can target 1 other "Ghostrick" card in your GY; add that target to your hand.

46918794.name: Tremendous Fire
46918794.description: Inflict 1000 points of damage to your opponent's Life Points and 500 points of damage to your Life Points.

47060347.name: Aegis of Gaia
47060347.description: Gain 3000 LP. If this face-up card leaves the field, the controller of this card takes 3000 damage.

47297616.name: Light and Darkness Dragon
47297616.description:
Cannot be Special Summoned. While face-up on the field, this card is also DARK-Attribute. Once per Chain, when a Spell/Trap Card, or monster effect, is activated (Quick Effect): If this card has 500 or more ATK and DEF, negate that activation, and if you do, this card loses exactly 500 ATK/DEF. If this card is destroyed and sent to the GY: Target 1 monster in your GY (if possible); destroy all cards you control, also, after that, Special Summon that monster (if any).

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

47325505.name: Fossil Dig
47325505.description: Add 1 Level 6 or lower Dinosaur monster from your Deck to your hand.

47346845.name: Batteryman AAA
47346845.description: When this card is Normal Summoned or flipped face-up, you can Special Summon 1 "Batteryman AAA" from your hand or Graveyard.

47355498.name: Necrovalley
47355498.description: All "Gravekeeper's" monsters gain 500 ATK/DEF. Cards in the GY cannot be banished. Negate any card effect that would move a card in the GY to a different place. Negate any card effect that changes Types or Attributes in the GY.

47453433.name: Back to Square One
47453433.description: Discard 1 card, then target 1 monster on the field; place that target on the top of the Deck.

47664723.name: Darklord Edeh Arae
47664723.description:
If this card is Special Summoned from the Graveyard, it gains this effect.
● If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

47737087.name: Elemental HERO Rampart Blaster
47737087.description:
"Elemental HERO Clayman" + "Elemental HERO Burstinatrix"
Must be Fusion Summoned. This card can attack directly while in Defense Position. If it does, apply its ATK for damage calculation, and its ATK is halved during damage calculation only.

47805931.name: Number 20: Giga-Brilliant
47805931.description:
2 Level 3 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; all face-up monsters you currently control gain 300 ATK.

48444114.name: Luna Light Perfume
48444114.description: Target 1 "Lunalight" monster in your GY; Special Summon it. You can banish this card from your GY, then discard 1 card; add 1 "Lunalight" monster from your Deck to your hand.

48461764.name: Purple Poison Magician
48461764.description:
[ Pendulum Effect ]
Once per turn, if your DARK Spellcaster-Type monster battles, before damage calculation: You can activate this effect; that monster gains 1200 ATK (until the end of the Damage Step), then destroy this card.
----------------------------------------
[ Monster Effect ]
(This card is always treated as a "Fusion Dragon" card.)
If this card is destroyed by battle or card effect: You can target 1 face-up card on the field; destroy it.

48608796.name: Lyrilusc - Assembled Nightingale
48608796.description:
2+ Level 1 monsters
Gains 200 ATK for each material attached to it. This card can attack directly. While this card has material, it can attack a number of times each Battle Phase, up to the number of materials attached to it. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card; until the end of this turn, "Lyrilusc" monsters you control cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects, also you take no battle damage.

48686504.name: Lonefire Blossom
48686504.description: Once per turn: You can Tribute 1 face-up Plant monster; Special Summon 1 Plant monster from your Deck.

48739166.name: Number 101: Silent Honor ARK
48739166.description:
2 Level 4 monsters
You can detach 2 materials from this card, then target 1 Special Summoned monster your opponent controls in face-up Attack Position; attach it to this card as material. You can only use this effect of "Number 101: Silent Honor ARK" once per turn. If this face-up card on the field would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can detach 1 material from this card instead.

48905153.name: Zoodiac Drident
48905153.description:
4 Level 4 monsters
Once per turn, you can also Xyz Summon "Zoodiac Drident" by using 1 "Zoodiac" monster you control with a different name as material. (Transfer its materials to this card.) Gains ATK/DEF equal to the ATK/DEF of all "Zoodiac" monsters attached to it as material. Once per turn (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 material from this card, then target 1 face-up card on the field; destroy it.

48976825.name: Burial from a Different Dimension
48976825.description: Target up to 3 banished monsters; return them to the GY.

49010598.name: Divine Wrath
49010598.description: When a monster effect is activated: Discard 1 card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that monster.

49080532.name: Infernity Beetle
49080532.description: While you have no cards in your hand, you can Tribute this card to Special Summon up to 2 "Infernity Beetle" from your Deck.

49398568.name: Serial Spell
49398568.description: Activate only when you activate one of your Normal Spell Cards. Discard all the cards in your hand to the Graveyard. The effect of this card becomes the same as the Normal Spell Card.

49684352.name: Double Iris Magician

96381979.name: Brotherhood of the Fire Fist - Tiger King
96381979.description:
2 Level 4 Beast-Warrior monsters
When this card is Xyz Summoned: You can Set 1 "Fire Formation" Spell/Trap directly from your Deck. Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card; negate the effects of all face-up Effect Monsters currently on the field, except Beast-Warriors, until the end of your opponent's turn. When this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can send 3 "Fire Formation" Spells/Traps you control to the GY; Special Summon 2 Level 4 or lower Beast-Warrior monsters with the same ATK from your Deck, in face-up Defense Position.

96570609.name: Ehther the Heavenly Monarch
96570609.description: You can Tribute Summon this card by Tributing 1 Tribute Summoned monster. If this card is Tribute Summoned: You can send 2 "Monarch" Spell/Trap Cards with different names from your hand and/or Deck to the Graveyard, and if you do, Special Summon 1 monster with 2400 or more ATK and 1000 DEF from your Deck, but return it to the hand during the End Phase. During your opponent's Main Phase, if this card is in your hand: You can banish 1 "Monarch" Spell/Trap Card from your Graveyard; immediately after this effect resolves, Tribute Summon this card (this is a Quick Effect).

96729612.name: Preparation of Rites
96729612.description: Add 1 Level 7 or lower Ritual Monster from your Deck to your hand, then you can add 1 Ritual Spell from your GY to your hand.

96930127.name: Chain Dog
96930127.description: Cannot be used as a Synchro Material, except for the Synchro Summon of a Beast-Type monster. If this card is in the Graveyard: You can Special Summon this card, and if you do, banish it when it leaves the field. You must control exactly 2 Beast-Type monsters to activate and to resolve this effect.

97017120.name: Giant Rat
97017120.description: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: You can Special Summon 1 EARTH monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck in Attack Position.

97077563.name: Call of the Haunted
97077563.description: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon that target in Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

97165977.name: Lunalight Panther Dancer
97165977.description:
"Lunalight Cat Dancer" + 1 "Lunalight" monster
Must first be Fusion Summoned with the above Fusion Materials. Cannot be destroyed by your opponent's card effects. Once per turn, during your Main Phase 1: You can activate this effect; for the rest of this turn, the first time each monster your opponent controls would be destroyed by battle, it is not destroyed, also this card can attack all monsters your opponent controls, twice each, this turn. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: This card gains 200 ATK until the end of the Battle Phase.

97169186.name: Smashing Ground
97169186.description: Destroy the 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that has the highest DEF (your choice, if tied).

97268402.name: Effect Veiler
97268402.description: During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can send this card from your hand to the GY, then target 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls; negate the effects of that face-up monster your opponent controls, until the end of this turn.

97489701.name: Red Nova Dragon
97489701.description:
2 Tuners + "Red Dragon Archfiend"
Gains 500 ATK for each Tuner in your GY. Cannot be destroyed by an opponent's card effects. When an opponent's monster declares an attack: You can target the attacking monster; banish this card, and if you do, negate that attack. Once per turn, during the End Phase, if this card was banished by its effect this turn: Special Summon this banished card.

97687912.name: Fairy Meteor Crush
97687912.description: If the equipped monster attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

97688360.name: Gouki Twistcobra
97688360.description: (Quick Effect): You can Tribute 1 "Gouki" monster, then target 1 "Gouki" monster you control; it gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the Tributed monster until the end of this turn. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 "Gouki" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Gouki Twistcobra". You can only use each effect of "Gouki Twistcobra" once per turn.

97836203.name: T.G. Halberd Cannon
97836203.description:
1 Tuner Synchro Monster + 2 or more non-Tuner Synchro Monsters
Must be Synchro Summoned, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Once per turn, during either player's turn, when a monster(s) would be Summoned: You can negate the Summon, and if you do, destroy that monster. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect. When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard: You can target 1 "T.G." monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

97949165.name: Lyrilusc - Turquoise Warbler
97949165.description: If you control no monsters, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If this card is Special Summoned from the hand: You can Special Summon 1 "Lyrilusc" monster from your hand or GY. You can only use this effect of "Lyrilusc - Turquoise Warbler" once per turn.

98045062.name: Enemy Controller

98239899.name: Blast with Chain
98239899.description: Target 1 face-up monster you control; equip this card to that target. It gains 500 ATK. If this card is destroyed by a card effect while equipped: Target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.

98494543.name: Magical Stone Excavation
98494543.description: Discard 2 cards, then target 1 Spell in your GY; add it to your hand.

98792570.name: Gift of the Martyr
98792570.description: Send 1 monster you control to the GY, then target 1 face-up monster you control; it gains ATK equal to the original ATK of the sent monster until the end of this turn.

99177923.name: Infernity Archfiend
99177923.description:
When you draw a card(s) while you have no cards in your hand, and you draw this card: You can reveal this card; Special Summon it from your hand. When this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Infernity" card from your Deck to your hand. You must have no cards in your hand to activate and to resolve this effect.

* The above text is unofficial and describes the card's functionality in the OCG.

99267150.name: Five-Headed Dragon
99267150.description:
5 Dragon monsters
Must be Fusion Summoned. Cannot be destroyed by battle with a DARK, EARTH, WATER, FIRE, or WIND monster.

99414168.name: Elemental Mistress Doriado
99414168.description: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Doriado's Blessing". The Attribute of this card is also treated as WIND, WATER, FIRE, and EARTH while it is face-up on the field.

99469936.name: Full Armored Crystalzero Lancer
99469936.description:
3 Level 6 WATER monsters
You can also Xyz Summon this card by using 1 Rank 5 WATER Xyz Monster you control. (Transfer its materials to this card.) Gains 500 ATK for each material attached to it. If this card on the field would be destroyed by battle or card effect, you can detach 1 material from this card instead. Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from this card; negate the effects of all face-up monsters your opponent currently controls, until the end of this turn.

99995595.name: Recycling Batteries
99995595.description: Target 2 Thunder-Type monsters with 1500 or less ATK in your Graveyard; add those targets to your hand.
